reviews.text:
Don't trust the positive reviews like I foolishly did! I should have realized that most of them come from unauthoritative and unreliable sources!

Ettore presents himself as a trustworthy and easygoing person, but behind that mask lies a completely different man, short-tempered and arrogant. Luckily, I discovered his true colors in time. My experience ended before I even left my dog ​​at the boarding facility, and the reason wasn't the facility, but the way I was treated.
It was the first time I'd left my dog ​​at a boarding facility, and to make her adjustment easier, I took her there several times to get to know the environment. The last time, when I picked her up, she was very agitated, panting, and I was told she hadn't been drinking. As a responsible owner, knowing I'd be hundreds of kilometers away and in high temperatures, I took the liberty of asking if, in a prolonged situation of stress and heat, there was anything to worry about.

Well, a legitimate and calm request for clarification (without a hint of accusation) was interpreted as a questioning of his professionalism, and was met with an offensive and unacceptable tone. Being a "dog trainer for twenty years," a phrase Ettore constantly uses, doesn't authorize him to raise his voice at a client who is politely raising a concern. Instead, I was rudely told that I was "overreacting," that it was my fault for transmitting anxiety to my dog, and the conversation escalated to shouting over the phone, with phrases like, "I don't want your dog." It's hard not to notice how he lowered his tone as soon as my husband intervened. He reserves his shouting for women.

Anyone who entrusts their pet to a foster home needs not only dog ​​training expertise, but also communication, a willingness to listen, and empathy for people. What more can I say? It's probably no coincidence that my dog ​​couldn't wait to escape that place.

The "firmness" that Ettore crudely attempts to attribute to himself in his response (obviously generated by ChatGPT) has another name: rudeness. Trust is fundamental to me, and I would never leave my dog ​​in the hands of someone like that. Since he reacted by yelling and insulting you over a simple question, imagine how he might treat your dogs while you're away...

Unfortunately, it was a very negative experience.
I brought our dog and we entrusted him to this center.
When we returned from vacation (9 days), we found our dog with a chronic cough. We said that if he was a small dog, it could happen.
After going to the doctor, we discovered that he had indeed been bitten by other dogs on his neck, feet, and buttocks, and was practically butchered.
The doctor was amazed at his resilience.
If I could give you 0 stars, I would give you 0 stars with all my heart. Throw the dogs to the wolves. This lack of professionalism is a must.
I left my puppy for a weekend, and when I picked him up, he was so happy. I felt comfortable leaving him because I saw how happy they were in their freedom.

I discovered this center by chance, which offers various services, including dog boarding. I left Eva here for a long time because, after meeting Ettore and seeing the vast space available, I thought it was the perfect place for her to feel comfortable, even in the company of other dogs.
Thank you

What can I say? Ettore is an extraordinary person, not only with humans but especially with dogs. I've been to him several times, and as soon as I heard about his boarding program, I immediately decided to leave my dog ​​there for several nights.
My dog ​​always comes back happy, changed, calm, and even more sociable than when I left him. Just by going there, you can understand the passion and commitment he puts into the dogs who stay with him, who see him as a figure to look up to and from whom they draw security. Like his staff, Damiano is a very sweet and knowledgeable guy.
Bring your dogs and you'll see what I mean.

It's a shame there are only 5 stars. A rare person who loves our furry friends, cuddles them, and lets them live outdoors during the day in an open environment. I've never seen such dedication. Our dog has been going to him for years. We highly recommend him.

For us, it's the best dog daycare in the Infernetto neighborhood. Ettore and his staff are very popular with our furry friends. The spaces are large and well-maintained. There's always fresh water and shade.
Wonderful place, competent and empathetic educators. Recommended.

A super positive experience, the daycare is highly recommended. My 3-year-old Luna is learning to interact with other dogs.
The van service is very convenient.
They come to the house to pick up and drop off the dog.
I had a great time! I couldn't imagine my dog ​​(Simba), who is always grumpy, being around so many dogs of different sizes and breeds and running around peacefully 🤩 Thanks guys!!! …

I take my Chihuahua Pierluigi to Asilo Canedocet in Ostia every morning and I couldn't be happier. At first, I thought I'd only take him when I had a lot of work, but he enjoys it so much that now he goes every day! They're so kind, so sweet, and you can tell they really love dogs. I couldn't have asked for a better experience, thank you so much!

I take Cloe to daycare once a week. Cloe isn't a dog like any other; she was adopted as an adult, rescued from a concentration camp where she'd been taken as a puppy.
Thanks to Ettore and Damiano, she's turning into a dog like any other. Cane Docet provides adequate space and attention for everyone. Top!!!!

Ettore is an excellent trainer.
He has a very calm approach based on respect for the dog's character.
And in his kennel, the dogs have a lot of fun; they all spend time together and …

I'm taking my well-behaved, well-trained, and sweet Rottweiler to a kennel, but the owner has decided not to take in molossoids. Sorry, but it makes me laugh...but then I think about it and say, "BETTER THIS WAY!" What a shame!!

Ettore is a fantastic trainer, empathetic and helpful, ready to listen to us and our furry friend. I'm really enjoying his method and learning dog body language.
Ettore and his staff are a guarantee for the education of our four-legged friends. The daycare is also a fantastic place, where dogs can interact safely and learn about social life. …
